### York Space Systems Expands Austin Presence with New Office


October 8, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/622448243/files/doc_news/York-Space-Systems-Expands-Austin-Presence-with-New-Office-2026.pdf)


*Larger facility supports software development for growing satellite constellations, future unmanned operations*


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[York Space Systems](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yorkspacesystems.com%2F&esheet=54616375&newsitemid=20261008005370&lan=en-US&anchor=York+Space+Systems&index=1&md5=82ee1c5b5a9c6cb57ab3dbe2971d10f0) (York) (NYSE: YSS), a leading, US-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-enabling solutions, today announced the opening of a larger Austin office to support the growth of its software team. The new facility builds on York’s longstanding investment in software, giving its Austin team more room to advance capabilities that are integral to its spacecraft platforms and an expanding range of national defense missions.


York Space System's new 8,400-square-foot office near Quarry Lake to support the growth of its software team.


The 8,400-square-foot office near Quarry Lake replaces York’s previous space in North Hyde Park. Designed to support software development, design, and testing, the larger facility gives York room to expand its Austin team and bring on additional technical talent. York established its Austin presence in 2023 through its acquisition of Emergent Space Technologies.


“Austin has been an exceptional home for this team, and this office is the next step as we grow to meet customer demand,” said Nate Cooper, VP of Space Vehicle Engineering at York. “Software is integral to our spacecraft platforms and every mission we support. Bringing our teams closer together will help us integrate software from the outset, move faster, and deliver more capable systems. That close connection between spacecraft, software, and mission operations is a defining strength for York.”


York’s investment in Austin supports its development of integrated systems across space, land, sea, and air, with space providing the backbone for communications and coordination. As defense customers deploy larger fleets of unmanned aircraft, vehicles, and maritime systems, York is developing the architecture to connect and coordinate those assets at scale, including in contested environments. Software plays a critical role in integrating these systems, managing missions, and adapting capabilities as operational needs change.


Austin’s depth of software and computer science talent, including its proximity to the University of Texas, makes it an important location for York’s continued growth. The company’s headquarters and primary manufacturing operations remain in Colorado.


**About York Space Systems**


[York Space Systems](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yorkspacesystems.com%2F&esheet=54616375&newsitemid=20261008005370&lan=en-US&anchor=York+Space+Systems&index=2&md5=db5db91aec13f3ee47efef0485b200ad) (NYSE: YSS) is a leading, U.S.-based national defense and commercial prime providing a comprehensive suite of mission-critical solutions for national security, government, and commercial customers. York is one of the only space and defense primes with proprietary hardware and software capabilities designed to address customers’ complex mission requirements across the critical elements of the entire space ecosystem throughout the mission lifecycle. York is purpose built to address evolving national security space challenges and to adapt to the ongoing shift in the U.S. government’s mission needs and procurement processes.
